name: Browse Saved Posters
description: The sequence that delivers the user-visible saved poster collection after the user opens the saved tab.

steps.description: UI requests the saved poster collection view.
preconditions: User has authenticated in this session
outcomes: Saved screen becomes the active composition

evidence.description: Router maps the saved tab to SavedPosterList.

steps.description: Hook requests data from the persistence/sync layer.
PosterSyncEngine reconciles local persistence with known truth.

branches.label: sync_failed
branches.description: Engine cannot reconcile persisted state with current truth.

branches.label: stale_state
branches.description: Local state is present but possibly outdated.

evidence.description: Rehydration logic is shared across saved-posters and detail availability screens.

steps.description: UI renders the saved collection from the reconciled state.
outcomes: Full collection rendered when state is fresh
Degraded collection rendered when state is stale or incomplete

evidence.description: Rendered collection relies on shared PosterCard tiles.

notes: This flow illustrates why user-visible symptoms may depend more on a shared system than on the visible UI file alone.
